{{Top|leg}}
'''''Tango''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] used by [[Airam (group)|Airam]] forces lead by [[Clan leader]] [[Tamaron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Retreat from Gallofree|helped]] rescue the personal of [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] ''[[Gallofree]]'' from two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], Tamaron agreed to replenish the Alliance's [[Warhead/Legends|Warhead]] supply in gratitude.

The meeting was to take place in his [[Asteroid/Legends|Asteroid]] [[Asteroid Hangar|Base]] ''[[Attila]]'' in the [[The Drift/Legends|Kuras Drift]]. '''Tango''', along with sister ship [[Charlie (cargo ferry)|''Charlie'']] and [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corvette]] ''[[Ignat]]'' and [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvette]] ''[[Tondar]]'' were present with warheads in their cargo. The Alliance sent cargo ferries ''[[Orrian]]'' and ''[[Lundi]]'' and [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] ''[[Condor (MC40a light cruiser)|Condor]]'' to pick up the Warheads with [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] to patrol the area and provide support if needed.

Sure enough [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from Rival clan leader and collaborator with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] [[Ilay]] arrived unscheduled and soon began to attack the base. After the T-wings were destroyed [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and Star Destroyer [[Wasp (Imperial-class)|''Wasp'']] arrived to disrupt operations. However both Squadrons held the Imperials forces long enough for the transactions to be completed and '''Tango''' along with the other Airam ships jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
